ننجلي (form VII)
# نَنْجَلِي (nanjalī) /nan.d͡ʒa.liː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْجَلَى (injalā)
# نَنْجَلِيَ (nanjaliya) /nan.d͡ʒa.li.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْجَلَى (injalā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
